### CVE-2001-0316
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2001-05-07 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 20626: Linux Kernel 2.2.x - 'sysctl()' Memory Reading (local/linux, 2001-02-09, verified=1)

Linux kernel 2.4 and 2.2 allows local users to read kernel memory and possibly gain privileges via a negative argument to the sysctl call.

### CVE-2001-0317
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2001-05-07 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 20720: Linux Kernel 2.2.18 (RedHat 6.2/7.0 / 2.2.14/2.2.18/2.2.18ow4) - ptrace/execve Race Condition Privilege Escalation (1) (local/linux, 2001-03-27, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 20721: Linux Kernel 2.2.18 (RedHat 6.2/7.0 / 2.2.14/2.2.18/2.2.18ow4) - ptrace/execve Race Condition Privilege Escalation (2) (local/linux, 2001-03-27, verified=1)

Race condition in ptrace in Linux kernel 2.4 and 2.2 allows local users to gain privileges by using ptrace to track and modify a running setuid process.

### CVE-2001-0907
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2004-09-01 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 21122: Linux Kernel 2.2/2.4 - Deep Symbolic Link Denial of Service (dos/linux, 2001-10-18, verified=1)

Linux kernel 2.2.1 through 2.2.19, and 2.4.1 through 2.4.10, allows local users to cause a denial of service via a series of deeply nested symlinks, which causes the kernel to spend extra time when trying to access the link.
